artworks.title: Man Seen from Behind with His Right Arm Extended
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body views of a figure, dressed identically, captured in a black and white illustration. Both figures are in profile view, facing away from each other, with one arm extended outward. The figures wear loose, knee-length pants and a long coat draped over one shoulder, fastened at the waist with a belt tied into a bow. A broad-brimmed hat adorned with a large feather tops the outfit. The headgear is prominently detailed. The illustration places the figures against a plain background, enclosed within a simple rectangular border, with no additional objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Two Women in Profile
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a simple line drawing style. One person is in a historical gown with a hat and curly hair. The second person wears a long coat, a hat, and holds a staff. Both are placed on a flat surface with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in full body length in a printed illustration. They are standing side by side, facing the left side of the image. Both women have their heads turned away, concealing their faces. They wear ornate hats with feathers, long flowing gowns with broad collars, and hold fur muffs in their hands. The background is plain with double lines framing the figures, emphasizing their attire.

artworks.title: Gentleman Wrapped in his Mantle
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing elaborate costumes. The drawing features two stylized figures, both adorned in exaggerated, theatrical outfits with wide-brimmed hats decorated with feathers, luxurious cloaks with fringed edges, and elaborate garters on their breeches. The figures are sketched in a manner that emphasizes their elegant stance, exuding a sense of flamboyance and theatricality. They are positioned side by side within a rectangular frame that encloses the composition.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two figures standing facing away. They wear wide-brimmed hats with feathers, long capes, and patterned trousers with lace-up details. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Gentleman in a Large Mantle, Front View
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length illustrated figures standing side by side. Both figures are wearing wide-brimmed hats with plumes, with one figure having multiple large plumes and the other having a singular prominent plume. Their facial features are stylized with elongated noses, pointed chins, and long, wavy hair under their hats. The figures are dressed in capes, puffed knee-length trousers, and sashes or ribbons at the waist. They are depicted wearing flat shoes and holding swords in different positions. The background is plain with a simple line border.

artworks.title: Peasant with a Cup
artworks.description: The image shows two identical line drawings of a full-body figure of a person standing in profile view, each positioned symmetrically on either side of the image. The person is shown wearing a brimmed hat and what appears to be a loose, long-sleeved shirt or jacket over baggy pants. The figure is holding a stick in one hand and a cylindrical object in the other. The facial features and hair of the figure are not detailed or distinguishable. The background is a plain, textured surface, with no additional elements or scenery, and the entire image is contained within a simple rectangular border.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Side
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body, side-by-side views of a person in an elaborate outfit. The person is positioned as if walking or posing with arms close to their body. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is tucked beneath a feathered hat. They wear a textured cape with a furry edge and pants cinched at the knee. The feet are covered by pointed shoes. The person appears to be holding a small rod or cane. The background is a plain, light-hued surface with a thin border framing the scene.

artworks.title: Peasant with Shovel on His Shoulder
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a landscape with a solitary figure. The drawing shows a lone figure standing on the right side, holding a tool, possibly a spade or shovel. The figure is dressed in loose clothing and a hat. Next to the figure is a barren tree. The background depicts a sparse landscape with a few lines indicating distant fields or hills. The image composition conveys a sense of solitude or contemplation against the simple, linear backdrop.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords
artworks.description: Two individuals are engaged in a sword fight. The image depicts two figures positioned in a dynamic stance, each gripping swords in their hands as they face each other. Both figures are dressed in period costumes, complete with breeches and significant headwear. Their stances suggest movement and tension, typical of a duel. The background is simple, with a lined border at the top and a barren landscape, emphasizing the focus on the central duel. The drawing captures a moment of balance and confrontation, with the figures seemingly frozen in time, their swords crossed. The lines are precise and stark, creating a strong silhouette effect.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords and Daggers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a sword fight. The figures are captured mid-action, each holding a rapier. They are in a duel, with one figure on the left ready to strike, while the other on the right is also in a defensive and attacking stance. Both figures are dressed in clothing reminiscent of the Renaissance or Baroque period, with puffed sleeves and detailed clothing. The background is minimal, drawing attention to the action between the two figures within a simple rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Peasant Attacked by Bees
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing on the left side with one arm raised outward and the other resting on a walking stick. A small dog stands on its hind legs next to him. The man wears historical-style clothing, possibly a hat with a feather, cloak, and breeches. Small black squares are around his outstretched hand. To the right, there is a small hill with a house and sparse trees. In the distance, there are gently rolling hills. The artwork features detailed yet minimalistic brushwork, focusing on outlines and contours. The color palette is monochromatic, with stark black lines and shading on a light beige background.

artworks.title: Peasant Removing His Shoe
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting under a tree on the right, wearing a cloak and a hat that partly covers his face. He leans against the tree. On the left, there is a mule facing away with its back visible. In the background, there are rolling hills and a small house or hut on one hill, partly hidden by trees. The horizon is formed by a line of hills. The artwork is created using fine line work and crosshatching, making it look textured in black and white. The sky is depicted with subtle horizontal lines indicating a clear or lightly clouded sky.

artworks.title: Peasant with Sack
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a landscape. The person is holding a walking stick in one hand and the other hand is by their side. Their facial expression appears somber, with a long nose and furrowed brow. The person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, loose-fitting clothing, long socks, and shoes. The background features a rocky landscape with sparse trees, and a large tree trunk on the right. The sky is clear with thin horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Peasant Defecating
artworks.description: The image depicts a crouched figure beside a path in a barren landscape. The figure has a hunched posture, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and thick clothing. They are situated near uneven terrain and textured rock-like formations or gnarled trees. A stout rodent-like creature is seen to the right, wandering near a simple fence bordering the path. The background is sparse, emphasizing isolation, and the composition relies on line work to show rugged textures and forms.

artworks.title: Dancers with Flute and Tambourine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in elaborate costumes engaging in dance or performance. The drawing features one character on the left with their arms raised, adorned in a lavishly decorated outfit with what appears to be a mask or headdress with large feathers or plumes. Their leg is lifted. On the right, another similarly dressed figure plays a wind instrument. The garment details include exaggerated sleeves and intricate patterns. The drawing captures a sense of rhythm and festivity through the positioning of the figures and the emphasis on their attire and movement.

artworks.title: Dancers with Lute
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two anthropomorphic figures. One figure wears a voluminous costume and a headpiece decorated with flowers, while the other figure wears an ornate outfit with feather-like decorations. The second figure is holding a long, staff-like object. The drawing is detailed and executed in a monochromatic style with strong linework. The background is minimal, emphasizing the two figures and their attire.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical figures in extravagant costumes and dynamic poses. The figures have elongated limbs and stylized postures. They are adorned with garments and headpieces suggesting movement and playfulness. The line work is simple against a plain background, emphasizing the figures' expressions. The scene is framed by a border, focusing on the characters.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body depictions of figures facing each other. Both are standing on their toes in a poised manner. The figures have facial features with prominent noses, pointed beards, fantastical ears, and curved horns. They have lean, muscular bodies with visible musculature. The figure on the left has one arm bent at the elbow with fingers pointing downward, while the other arm is raised to the shoulder. The figure on the right holds a long staff or stick against their back, with one hand behind their back and the other arm at their side. The background is plain with horizontal lines suggesting a surface, all enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Shepherd Playing Flute
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd watching over animals, with a distant structure resembling a castle on the left. The style uses black and white contrasts to define the forms. The shepherd stands under a tree, with swirling lines indicating a breeze. The color palette is subdued, focusing on contrasts. The image conveys a serene moment with attention to line work and detail.

artworks.title: Almshouse
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene in what appears to be a courtyard or open space adjacent to a one-story building with arches and a roof extending forward. A man with a wide-brimmed hat gestures towards the scene. The brushstrokes are linear, resembling a woodcut or engraving style. The palette is monochromatic with varying tones of black against a beige canvas.

artworks.title: Tavern
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene near buildings. The drawing depicts a busy outdoor area with multiple figures engaged in various activities. To the left, a large figure stands in front of a tree. Near the center, several figures are gathered around a large wooden structure. In the background, a building with a sloped roof and arched entrance is visible. The area is lined with trees, and various small animals or birds can be seen on the ground. The line work and depiction of structures and figures suggest a focus on social gatherings or communal activities in a rural or semi-urban setting.

artworks.title: Military Commander on Foot
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in a dramatic pose on what looks like a battleground. The person is holding a long stick or staff pointed forward. The attire includes a tall, plumed hat and draped fabric. The scene is outdoors with a group of spear-bearing figures in the background. The drawing is enclosed within a simple rectangular frame.

artworks.title: Military Commander on Horseback
artworks.description: The image depicts a person riding a rearing horse. The rider holds a baton and sits upright in the saddle. The person's features are not detailed, but they have long hair flowing from under a feathered helmet. The rider wears period-appropriate attire that suggests armor or a military uniform with a cape. The horse is shown in a lively pose, adding movement to the image. In the background is a vast landscape with a battlefield scene and a fortified structure or city on a hill.
